تنتقدي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِدِي (tantaqidī) /tan.ta.qi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# تُنْتَقَدِي (tuntaqadī) /tun.ta.qa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
